intro: Cambodia is a low-lying country around a great lake, the Tonlé Sap, and the Mekong River.

chapters.title: The lake that changes size
text: In the rainy season the Mekong floods so much that the Tonlé Sap river reverses its flow, and the lake swells to several times its dry-season size. It is one of the world's richest freshwater fisheries.
Mountains like the Cardamoms in the south-west hold rainforest with elephants.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Cambodia is tropical, with a rainy season from May to October.

keyTerms.meaning: Flat land that floods when a river rises.
